scenario.title: 84.000 V is a legal pack, 84.001 V faults
scenario.description: Walk the over-voltage limit across its inclusive boundary. At exactly 84000 mV the pack must stay quiet on the fault identifier, with the reading confirmed by a read-back of the rule's own input. One millivolt higher the fault frame must carry OVERVOLT, and the pack's telemetry must corroborate the reading it faulted on. The fault must then survive the pack returning to 72.000 V, because rule 2 is latched.

steps.params: pack driven to exactly 84.000 V, the inclusive limit

params.label: 84.000 V is legal: no fault frame for 300 ms
the value the rule compares really is 84.000 V
still legal 600 ms in: nothing about 84.000 V is a fault
84.001 V faults with OVERVOLT within 50 ms
the pack publishes the 84.001 V it faulted on

steps.params: pack back to 72.000 V, the fault must not clear

params.label: OVERVOLT stays latched after the pack returns to 72.000 V
